baseline.scope: Previous source snapshot with uncontrolled caches; not a measurement of this implementation

changes: Bind native C# terrain, water, surface-context and managed scalar delegates directly for route solving, cave networks, cave fields, portal surfaces and chamber profiles; keep generic provider fallback
Use one immutable lateral fraction table instead of allocating one per route station
Stop canonical non-publishing entrance exposure probes after a conclusive positive result; custom providers retain all original probes
Stop canonical non-publishing chamber footprint probes after rejection; every accepted chamber retains all roof/depth checks
Cache successful launcher builds by engine, SDK, source/project/ancestor build-input hashes and all required output hashes; continue .NET import repair on direct runs
limitations: No fresh runtime suite, benchmark, cold-start or traversal run for this implementation
Remaining generation time depends on canonical terrain sampling and full cave-region discovery; the numerical speedup is not yet measured
